summary: Ruga Ragetotem awaits skilled warriors in Camp Taurajo, where a trial may test your growing renown. Speak with him to learn whether you are ready.

sections.title: A Call to Warriors
sections.body: Warriors of growing renown are called to Ruga Ragetotem in Camp Taurajo, within the Barrens. You have come at the invitation of Torm Ragetotem, Sorek, or Baltus Fowler. Ruga is waiting to hear whether you seek his trial.

faq.answer: Ruga Ragetotem is waiting in Camp Taurajo to offer a trial to warriors.
Ruga Ragetotem is in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.

faq.q: Why am I speaking with Ruga?
faq.answer: Torm Ragetotem, Sorek, or Baltus Fowler sent you to speak with Ruga about his trial for skilled warriors.

faq.q: What does Ruga want from me?
faq.answer: Ruga asks whether you have come for his trial.

angles.text: As a warrior, you are among those Ruga calls to his trial.
Ruga's call is for warriors, and he waits in Camp Taurajo.
